writing.overall_comment: A well-structured, clearly bounded Java backend agent whose main weakness is duplicated content that could be trimmed without losing any guidance.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly signals Spring Boot/MyBatis enterprise Java work, though it understates the broader scope (Spring Cloud, Kafka, scheduling) covered in the body.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, expertise, principles, and an explicit output contract (complete layered deliverables plus a build/test report) are all present and actionable.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A dedicated Boundaries section states what is out of scope and names concrete handback targets (system-architect, java-unit-test) with ambiguity triggers.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The prompt repeats content across sections (skills listed twice, exception handling restated, the 8-step code workflow duplicating Core Principles), inflating the token budget without adding routing value.

suggestions: Remove the duplicate skills list from the second skills section and keep only one canonical skills block in the prompt.
Delete the restated exception-handling guidance from the repeated location and leave a single authoritative exception-handling statement.
Condense the 8-step code workflow by removing steps already covered in Core Principles or replacing the workflow with a pointer to Core Principles.
